greeting.text: "You. Kai told me what you did at the bar. Keep walking."
"Council meeting ran long. Again. What is it?"
"Vera Lind, dam engineer. If this is about the dam: it's fine. I checked the numbers yesterday."

replies.text: "Concrete, 1961. Old, but she holds. If you want the truth, read the gauge by the dam. Numbers don't lie."
"Says who? Bring me a measurement, not a feeling."
"I don't take help from thieves."
"You've been pestering me all day. Go away."
"9.4? That's over the red line... If that's true, only the relief valve can save us. But the key went missing with old Oskar."
"Where did you get that? I don't take help from thieves."
"Oskar's key! Then there's still time. Out of my way!" She runs for the Valve Hut.
"A rusty old key? Lovely. Why would I need that?"

greeting.text: "The bus is late. Of course it is."
"We're closed. I've got a bus to catch."

replies.text: "Old Oskar used to say the water talks before it moves. Maybe that's why I'm leaving."
"Anywhere. 10:20 bus. I'm done with Marrow."
He stares at you. "How do you know about that? ...Fine. Take it. I'm never coming back anyway."

greeting.text: "Pharmacy's open. Headaches, heartaches, nothing in between."

replies.text: "My father kept that dam for thirty years. Oskar. The council retired him and stopped listening."
"The valve key? Dad gave the spare to Tomas, to cover his bar tab. He thought it was hilarious."

greeting.text: "Citizens of Marrow! Oh, it's you. Enjoying the speech?"
"Halden, mayor. Come to the square at eleven, I'm giving a speech!"

replies.text: "The dam was inspected last spring. Totally safe. Write that down."
"Nonsense! Spread panic in my town and I'll have you arrested."

greeting.text: "Bet you can't catch me! ...oh. You did."

replies.text: "Tomas is getting the 10:20 bus. He's leaving for good! He gave me free lemonade."
"OK but don't tell. The bar's back door doesn't lock when Tomas is gone. Free lemonade!"
"Not here, someone could hear! Ask me at the Mill."

greeting.text: "Mari, Vera's assistant. I keep the hut tidy. Vera keeps the dam... upright."

replies.text: "Vera only believes measurements. Check the gauge by the dam late morning, it climbs after eleven."
"Right here in the hut. Only Vera can turn it. From the Town Hall it's a long walk, so don't leave it late."
